{{Quote|Intel put Ondorru on Fest with nothing but soldiers and factories for company. We launched at full burn, dropped everything we had&mdash; and now we're here.|Tobin Harlan, on Dagger's Wing disgrace and incarceration on Belsavis|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] legendary [[Dagger Wing]] undertook '''an unauthorized mission to bomb''' [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith–Imperial]] citizens on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. The bombing of Fest resulted in thousands of civilian [[Death/Legends|deaths]] and drove [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] commanders to imprison Dagger Wing in the [[Belsavis prison]].
